  private AmazonRoute53Client getAmazonRoute53Client(EurekaServerConfig serverConfig) {
    String aWSAccessId = serverConfig.getAWSAccessId();
    String aWSSecretKey = serverConfig.getAWSSecretKey();
    ClientConfiguration clientConfiguration =
        new ClientConfiguration().withConnectionTimeout(serverConfig.getASGQueryTimeoutMs());

    if (null != aWSAccessId
        && !"".equals(aWSAccessId)
        && null != aWSSecretKey
        && !"".equals(aWSSecretKey)) {
      return new AmazonRoute53Client(
          new BasicAWSCredentials(aWSAccessId, aWSSecretKey), clientConfiguration);
    } else {
      return new AmazonRoute53Client(new InstanceProfileCredentialsProvider(), clientConfiguration);
    }
  }

  private boolean hasValue(
      @Nullable ResourceRecordSetWithHostedZone resourceRecordSetWithHostedZone, String ip) {
